title.narrative: MHPSS Burundi – MHPSS Specialist with UNICEF

description.narrative: As part of UNICEF’s commitment to strengthening mental health and psychosocial support services (MHPSS) in Burundi, UNICEF seeks the Netherlands Enterprise Agencies (RVO’s) support for the deployment of an MHPSS specialist. The initial deployment will be finalised on July 9, 2026. Yet, the need on the ground is enormous and recent Ebola outbreak in the region necessitated an extension to accomplish preparedness, therefore UNICEF submitted an extension request to this deployment. This expertise will be instrumental in facilitating the establishment and structuring of a dedicated MHPSS Technical Working Group (TWG), with UNICEF serving as the hosting organization.The objective of this initiative is to establish a coordination mechanism among key stakeholders, ensure better integration of MHPSS approaches within national public health and humanitarian policies, and support the development of standards and operating procedures tailored to the Burundian context. Through this support, the project partners also aim to foster experience sharing, strengthen capacity-building efforts, and improve monitoring and evaluation mechanisms for MHPSS interventions.
